basic_info.description: Mid-century modern home in tranquil Midtown Terrace, a coveted enclave in Central San Francisco, offering privacy and stunning panoramic ocean and hill views. Known for its greenbelts and scenic trails, including Twin Peaks vistas. The lush entry leads to an open living area with a limestone gas fireplace, expansive windows, and dining area. A Japonesque-influenced kitchen features a three-door pantry and antique Japanese tansus. Light oak hardwood floors unify open spaces, designed by the architect-owner for entertaining or quiet reflection. Main floor includes a large primary suite and two additional bedrooms, one used as an office with custom shelving. Lower level has Italian porcelain tile with radiant heating, a dedicated office with custom maple shelves, and a second full primary suite. Outside, a Japanese-inspired garden with a fountain, California Native plants, and succulents completes the serene atmosphere.
